items.headline: Car crashes through fences into Jamaica Plain home; two hurt
items.blurb: Two people inside a car were freed by firefighters with minor injuries after it struck a home on Glen Road Monday afternoon. Officials said speed appears to have been a factor; the crash remains under investigation.

items.headline: Northeastern police investigating scammers posing as ICE agents
items.blurb: Northeastern University's police chief told student government that officers are investigating numerous cases of people impersonating ICE agents to target students.

items.headline: Tip jar theft suspect charged after two officers hurt in South End arrest
items.blurb: Police say a 28-year-old Brockton man took a tip jar from a bakery at 345 Harrison Ave. and injured two officers while resisting. He faces larceny, assault on police and resisting arrest charges.

items.headline: Two women shot on Davison Street in Hyde Park
items.blurb: Two women were shot near 114 Davison St. around 1:10 a.m. Saturday; one was reported to have life-threatening injuries. No arrests were reported.

items.headline: Hyde Park man charged after loaded revolver found in Mattapan stop
items.blurb: B-3 officers stopped a vehicle at Delhi Street and Wooddale Avenue early Friday and arrested Kareem Seales, 24, on unlicensed firearm and ammunition charges.

items.headline: Allston stabbing survivor calls for more mental health resources
items.blurb: One of three men stabbed near Cambridge and Highgate streets on Oct. 4 spoke publicly, urging more mental health and recovery services to help prevent violence.

items.headline: Woman shot inside Washington Street home in Dorchester
items.blurb: A woman was shot shortly before 8 p.m. Thursday near Washington and Armandine streets and taken to a hospital. Police reported no arrests.

items.headline: Boston man pleads guilty in federal firearms trafficking case
items.blurb: A Boston man pleaded guilty in federal court in Boston to firearm trafficking charges, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office.

items.headline: Second defendant pleads guilty to manslaughter in 2023 Mass and Cass killing
items.blurb: Crystal Morgan, 41, was sentenced to six to eight years for a fatal 2023 stabbing on Topeka Street. A co-defendant earlier received 10 to 15 years.

items.headline: Dorchester man faces gun charges after foot chase in Mattapan
items.blurb: Police say officers recovered a firearm in a Mallard Avenue driveway and arrested Corey Perfect Jean-Little, 22, near Talbot Avenue Tuesday night on multiple firearm charges.

items.headline: Two teens charged with armed robbery at Ashmont liquor store
items.blurb: Two juveniles, 14 and 15, are charged in an Oct. 1 incident at a Dorchester Avenue liquor store; one also faces an assault charge. Both were released with stay-away orders.

items.headline: Cambridge man charged after alleged attacks in Blackstone Square
items.blurb: Police say Sharkell Tariq Matthews, 26, assaulted several people, including an elderly person, and two officers in the South End park Monday evening.

items.headline: Police seek four seen entering South Station Tower garage
items.blurb: Detectives are asking for help identifying four people who allegedly entered a parking garage at 680 Atlantic Ave. through an unlocked door on Sept. 7.

items.headline: Transit Police seek man who broke fare gate at JFK/UMass
items.blurb: MBTA Transit Police released video of a man they say forced his way through a fare gate to leave the station Sunday night, breaking a plexiglass panel.

items.headline: Person stabbed on Stellman Road in Roslindale; two teens sought
items.blurb: A person was stabbed near 37 Stellman Rd. around 1:30 p.m. and hospitalized with injuries not considered life-threatening. Police were seeking two masked teens.

items.headline: Man charged with trying to disarm officers near Mass. Ave.
items.blurb: Police say Felix Omar David Marrero, 34, struggled with officers responding to a drug-use complaint near 690 Massachusetts Ave. He also had outstanding drug warrants.

items.headline: 18-year-old charged with murder in Hyde Park gas station shooting
items.blurb: Christian Peebles, 18, of Boston was arrested Friday and charged with murder in the Oct. 7 shooting at 1171 Hyde Park Ave. He faces arraignment in West Roxbury court.

items.headline: Grove Hall woman sentenced to 5 to 7 years in infant daughter's death
items.blurb: Raynell Reed, 32, pleaded guilty to involuntary manslaughter in Suffolk Superior Court and received a 5-to-7-year state prison term.

items.headline: Brighton man charged in Allston triple stabbing after knife call
items.blurb: Joshua Flores, 24, was arrested on Western Avenue after a report of a man swinging a knife, then charged with armed assault to murder in the Oct. 4 stabbings.

items.headline: Youth Violence Strike Force recovers loaded gun in Roxbury
items.blurb: Officers arrested a 16-year-old and recovered a loaded firearm near Mount Pleasant and Dudley streets on Oct. 7 after community complaints, police say.

items.headline: Police seek pair in tip jar theft at Jamaica Plain restaurant
items.blurb: Detectives want help identifying two people who allegedly took a tip jar from a restaurant at 3160 Washington St. on Oct. 8.

items.headline: City security director agrees to plead guilty in COVID loan fraud
items.blurb: Reuben Taylor, 40, director of Boston's Municipal Protective Services, agreed to plead guilty to wire fraud over a $20,804 PPP loan, prosecutors say.

items.headline: Man fatally shot inside Hyde Park Avenue gas station
items.blurb: A man was shot inside a gas station and store at 1171 Hyde Park Ave. around 5:09 p.m. and died at a hospital. Police said it did not appear random.

items.headline: Revere man charged in Warren Street stabbing after knife found on roof
items.blurb: Detectives arrested Meshach Dowman, 31, on assault with intent to murder and mayhem charges in the Sept. 29 stabbing near 301 Warren St.

items.headline: Fourth person charged in deadly June shooting in Mattapan Square
items.blurb: Cerrone Wilcox Buford, 19, of Jamaica Plain is charged with first-degree murder in the June 27 shooting at 1460 Blue Hill Ave. and held without bail.

items.headline: Police seek man in Jamaica Plain assault on South Huntington Avenue
items.blurb: Detectives are asking for help identifying a man who allegedly punched someone without warning near 105 South Huntington Ave. on Sept. 25.

items.headline: Quincy man charged with gun possession after Dorchester traffic stop
items.blurb: Police say a loaded firearm was found during a stop near 54 Washington St. Johnny Williams Delacruz, 27, faces firearm and stolen property charges.

items.headline: Three men stabbed near Cambridge Street in Allston
items.blurb: Three people were stabbed near Highgate and Cambridge streets shortly before 1:30 a.m.; police said the injuries were not life-threatening.

items.headline: Man stabbed at Tremont Street and Temple Place downtown
items.blurb: A man was stabbed in the neck during a fight around 11 p.m. Friday near Downtown Crossing, and the homicide unit was called in. No arrests were reported.

items.headline: Five juveniles charged in Roxbury break-in involving mopeds
items.blurb: Officers responding to a larceny in progress on Maywood Street arrested five teens, ages 14 to 17, on breaking and entering and related charges.

items.headline: 20-year-old charged with murder in Whitfield Street shooting
items.blurb: Joseph Bailey, 20, of Dorchester is charged with murder after a man was fatally shot near 7 Whitfield St. on Sept. 30, police say.

items.headline: Transit Police seek man in Red Line punch that broke senior's jaw
items.blurb: Police say a man punched a rider over 60 without provocation on a train at Shawmut station on Sept. 22. The suspect has not been identified.

items.headline: Man gets 5 1/2 years in federal prison for Heath Street Gang role
items.blurb: Tyrre Herring pleaded guilty to a racketeering charge and was also barred from Heath Street and the Mildred Hailey Apartments for three years after release.

items.headline: Man slashed at Warren Street McDonald's in Roxbury
items.blurb: A man was cut in the face around 7:10 p.m. Tuesday at the restaurant at 301 Warren St. An arrest was later announced.

items.headline: Lowell man held on $50,000 bail in fatal Jamaicaway crash
items.blurb: Luis Bermudez Torres, 23, is charged with manslaughter and reckless motor vehicle homicide in an Aug. 17 crash on the Jamaicaway, prosecutors say.

items.headline: Roslindale man charged after loaded gun found in Mattapan traffic stop
items.blurb: Police say a 9mm pistol was found during a stop near Franklin Field. Driver Starlin Bonnet, 24, faces gun and drug charges; three passengers had warrants.

items.headline: Six-alarm fire strikes historic Edison Building in Nubian Square
items.blurb: A basement fire at 72 Warren St. grew to six alarms Monday morning; firefighters fought it from outside and urged people to avoid the area.

items.headline: Man charged with attempted murder after ShotSpotter alert in Roxbury
items.blurb: Police arrested Jermaine Blackman, 29, after shots near Pauline Bennett Way and Smith Street on Sept. 25. No injuries were reported.

items.headline: Homicide unit investigates fatal shooting at Walter Street business
items.blurb: A 37-year-old Milton man was shot and pronounced dead inside a business near 54 Walter St. on Sept. 26. No arrests were announced.
